caption_lead: Ablation of gate groups, reasoned from the gate definitions rather than measured by recompiling the checker.
caption_tail: Each row removes one group of gates and records the class of defect that then escapes detection. The last row is the one whose consequence a reader cannot see unaided, and because the rows are independent rather than ordered levels there is no digit column to receive a best marking, while the yes and no verdicts are at the same level of confidence rather than a ranking.
footnotes: 'Visible to reader' means detectable without running the checker, by reading the draft once.
